The '''Amban phase-pulse blaster''' was a type of two-pronged [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] used an Amban phase-pulse blaster to save [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] from a [[Panna dragon]] on [[Panna Prime]].

==Description==
The Amban phase-pulse [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]<ref name="Character Key">{{Rebelscum|subdomain=threads|url=photogallery/data/500/medium/JPG_boba_holiday-ck.jpg|text=BOBA FETT Character Key}}</ref> was a type of handheld blaster technology. The weapon had a [[Stock/Legends|stock]] at its base and a grip near its forked end. The Amban phase-pulse blaster could be used at a medium range, and it was capable of fighting off large [[Species/Legends|creatures]].<ref name="Holiday Special" />

==History==
{{Quote|You saved my life. Thank you.|Luke Skywalker, to Boba Fett|<ref name="The Star Wars Holiday Special">''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Star-Wars-Boba-Fett-animated-version-sixth-scale-hot-toys.png|thumb|right|175px|Boba Fett carried an Amban phase-pulse blaster.]]
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="1 ABY">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=870#15778940|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-12|time=6:13 PM|quote=Wookiee Life Day occurs every 3 years, one of which fell at ~1.5 ABY.}}</ref> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] wielded one such weapon. While on the mud-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Panna Prime]], Fett witnessed the young [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] come under attack by a [[Panna dragon]], which began to [[Diet/Legends|devour]] the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter]]. Skywalker's [[Defender sporting blaster pistol/Legends|Defender sporting blaster pistol]] had no effect on the beast, so Fett intervened. From the back of a [[Paar's ichthyodont]], the bounty hunter fired his Amban phase-pulse blaster at the dragon, and it retreated. After the incident, Skywalker thanked Fett for saving his life.<ref name="Holiday Special" />
{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Amban phase-pulse blaster first appeared in "[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]," an animated segment of [[1978]]'s ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'',<ref name="Holiday Special" /> and it was named in the production's Boba Fett character key.<ref name="Character Key" />

The design of the Amban phase-pulse blaster was repurposed for [[Chop'aa Notimo]]'s [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]] in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''.<ref name="Force Unleashed">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

In [[2020]], a version of the Amban phase-pulse blaster, named the [[Amban JP blaster rifle]], was added to the online multiplayer game [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic''{{'s}} Cartel Market]] to commemorate the release of the second season of [[Star Wars: The Mandalorian|''The Mandalorian'']].<ref name="TOR">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20201124|text=The Making of Gear Inspired by "The Mandalorian"}}</ref>
